Marissa — thanks for the clear breakdown. A few legal/operational clarifications and an internal playbook I want to lock before we reply to Acme: 

1) Signature ordering: we prefer countersign within 48 business hours (24 workable but risky over holidays). We'll commit to 24 hours only if the SOW and any final redlines are accepted and no new commercial terms are introduced.
2) Key approvals to close in Redwood:
   - Legal (me): final terms, indemnities, data residency clause checked
   - Security (Neha): SOC2 evidence and KMS integration confirmation 
   - Sales Ops (Sean): provisioning window and first-week resources scheduled
3) eSign logistics: I will generate the DocuSign envelope and include the SOW and the PO placeholder as exhibits. Please confirm the signers' emails for Acme so I can pre-populate routing.
4) Start date gating: we need the countersigned SOW + signed PO by Dec 15 to make Dec 20 Day 1; otherwise default to Jan 4. If Procurement wants an earlier pilot-only scope start, we can produce a reduced-scope kickoff agreement (one-week pilot addendum).

I'll prepare the envelope today and share the link in the reply. Sean, can you confirm ops availability for a Dec 20 kickoff if everything clears by Dec 15? Camila / Marissa, please confirm Acme signers' emails so I can set routing.

Attachments: internal-legal-issues-notes.txt (attachment stub)

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
